# FFmpeg Auto-Assemble

Assemble a finished ecommerce short video from a storyboard.json in one local ffmpeg pipeline: Edge-TTS voice-over, Ken Burns or trimmed-clip shots, xfade transitions, burned-in styled subtitles, locally synthesized BGM with voice ducking, and two-pass loudness normalisation to about -14 LUFS — MP4 (9:16 by default) plus an .srt file.
